text:
arjun: Quick sync — proposing token affinity for org/project keys so edge routing prefers the same Dedicated pool and reduces cold KV cache misses. Suggest adding an `aff` claim like `aff:dedicated-us-east-123` in issued JWTs.

michaela: +1 on affinity to reduce tail, but quota/accounting worries. If a request is rerouted we must keep billing deterministic: token -> org -> quota shard mapping should be stable.

ben: Agreed on metering. Also keep the claim tiny (<=32 chars) to avoid bloating tokens. Server-side should expand the slug to pool details.

olivia: From a console/telemetry POV we'll need labels: `affinity_tag`, `affinity_hit`, `routing_policy`, `fallback_reason` so we can measure p50/p95 impact.

arjun: Plan: `aff` is a short slug. Edge router reads it and, if matching pool available, routes and emits affinity_hit=true. Otherwise fallback to compatible pool, emit affinity_hit=false and set fallback_reason enum (capacity|incompatible|unknown).

michaela: Billing question: what if fallback pool has different pricing (Dedicated reserved vs Hosted metered)?

ben: Billing must canonicalize to org/project from the token for quota/charge. Affinity affects only routing/caching, not billing lookup. We'll add a `billing_key` label in logs/metrics to enable joins.

olivia: Console will join routing telemetry with billing_key to show accurate cost deltas. Need a per-org view for affinity hit rate and cost savings estimate.

sam: Edge-case: legacy long opaque API keys used by service accounts. Do we require re-issuance to JWTs or support a header override like `X-Redwood-Affinity`?

arjun: Support both. JWT claim is authoritative if present. Header can be allowed for legacy keys but must be validated by control-plane (signed nonce/short TTL) before we honor it.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: edge-router-affinity-v1 -> staging

ben: Rollout UX: enable affinity-by-default for 10% of traffic (canary) with console toggle per-organization so teams can experiment.

olivia: UI needs a lightweight panel: per-org affinity hit rate, affinity_miss cost delta, and a timeline for affinity toggles and canary percentage.

michaela: Telemetry schema suggestion (minimal):
```
metric: inference.request
labels:
  - org_id
  - project_id
  - affinity_tag
  - affinity_hit (true/false)
  - routing_policy (affinity|regional|cost|legacy)
  - fallback_reason (none|capacity|incompatible|unknown)
```

arjun: Add `route_latency_ms` and `kv_cache_miss` boolean to the metrics. Also emit `edge_pool_id` when routing decision is made.

sam: For tokens without org_id (old multi-tenant fallback), default to `routing_policy:legacy` and regional routing; emit an audit note so platform teams can migrate customers.

ben: Security: control-plane must vouch for allowed affinity slugs. Do not accept arbitrary tags from clients. Token issuance should sign aff claim and map slug->pool id server-side.

olivia: Console feature: Dedicated -> Routing shows pools with capacity, recent affinity misses, and a manual `rebind tenant` action (manual handoff). Manual rebind must emit an audit event and be available only to admins.

michaela: Alerting: create rule `affinity_miss_rate > 5% for 5m` -> pager oncall. Otherwise regressions slip by.

arjun: Implementation checklist for PRs:
- control-plane: add `aff` claim issuance (ttl, signing)
- edge: read `aff`, route, emit labels including `affinity_hit` and `fallback_reason`
- billing: ignore `aff` for quota lookup, add `billing_key` label
- metrics: add `affinity_hit`, `affinity_miss_count`, `affinity_miss_cost`, `route_latency_ms`, `kv_cache_miss`
- console: org toggle, per-org affinity dashboard, audit log for manual actions
- alerting: affinity_miss_rate > 5% -> pager

arjun: I'll split work and tag reviewers. Target: canary to 10% in staging this week, console widgets ready for the canary, full rollout after 2 weeks of monitoring.

olivia: Add migration notes for service accounts in PR template and include a short FAQ for customers about what affinity means for latency/cost.

ops-bot: created ticket INF-4821 for affinity rollout + dashboards

michaela: Leaving this checklist in thread as well. Ping me for review on control-plane and metrics.
